description: Om Freight Forwarders Limited provides third party logistics services through sea, road, rail, and air in India. It offers international freight forwarding, customs clearance, vessel agency, transportation, warehousing, and distribution services. The company engages in the handling and transportation of Over dimensional, heavy lifts, breakbulk, sensitive, and dry bulk cargo, as well as large, heavy, and non-containerized cargo. Om Freight Forwarders Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
